facts.fact: 卧室里摆满三大瓶粉色玫瑰，Rory 一眼认出是 Gabriel 送的；她上次见到更多花是在母亲的游园会上——她在那里拒绝了 Terren 的追求，此后多年成为他鄙视的对象。
facts.anchor: Roses overflowed from three large crystal vases. The room thickened with their perfumed aroma.

facts.fact: Gabriel 留条道歉：承认昨晚行为失当、失去控制，声称这让他更明白自己深爱 Rory，发誓会努力克制、等她准备好；并邀她与 Cora 于下午茶后一小时同去 Themis 神庙礼拜，届时亲自来接。
facts.anchor: My behavior last night was most unbecoming. I lost control of my urges. It has deepened my understanding of how much I am enamored with you, and I vow to put forth the effort of controlling myself better until you are ready.

facts.fact: Cora 说出心里话：她喜欢 Darragh 队长——他话不多，但接送她上下学时会往她手里塞焦糖糖、偶尔讲傻笑话、总问她过得好不好、有没有人亏待她；Rory 想起几天前发现的糖纸，意识到 Darragh 一直在暗中照看她们母女。
facts.anchor: Cora giggled a little like she had revealed a secret. “Once in a while, he would tell me a silly joke, too. Always asked about my day and if everyone treats me well.”

facts.fact: Anya 读完 Gabriel 的信把它甩到桌上，说 Rory 的情绪泛滥到她昨晚不得不暂时退出自己的共感 enchant；Rory 于是把一切告诉 Anya：mead 配方藏在磨墙里的推测、人类被贩卖到 Tironaill 的传言、自己遭袭击、Gabriel 在练武室的举动、昨晚 Darragh 把 Gabriel 从她身上拉开又来她房间的事。
facts.anchor: She flung his letter onto a table when she finished reading. “What did he do? Your emotions are all over the place, even now, and last night I had to tune out of my enchant because of how much you flooded it.”

facts.fact: Anya 用共感能力读 Gabriel：他对 Rory 只有 lust 和欣快，没有应有的爱、钦慕与敬重，还压着一种她说不清的情绪；她评价 Gabriel 精于算计、贪恋权力、自视甚高，并劝 Rory 不必因他帮过忙就觉得欠他感情。
facts.anchor: I can feel his lust and a sort of giddiness, but I don’t feel the love, admiration, and respect for you coming off him like he should. He is holding something back. An emotion I can’t quite place.

facts.fact: Anya 解释：多数 seraph 因 Darragh 同时是 angheal 与 daemonite 血统而怕他、不喜欢他，但他的卫兵敬他、几名仆人暗中喜欢他；她不时读他的情绪，从未发现其意图有问题、认为他是好人——Rory 由此想到 Anya 与 Lieutenant Osman 正有秘密恋情。
facts.anchor: Yes, most seraphs fear Darragh and don’t like him because he is both angheal and daemonite,” she agreed. “A silly reason to hate someone, if you ask me, but his guards respect him and several staff members like him, but secretly.

facts.fact: Anya 建议 Rory 继续查答案，同时扮演「对 Gabriel 仍有复杂感情」的甜美人类贵族、守住身体界限、声明要按自己的节奏慢慢来；她还断言 Darragh 撑不了多久就不会再躲着 Rory。
facts.anchor: If I were you, I would continue to search for your answers while playing the part of the sweet human noble who occasionally bats her eyes at him to make him think you still harbor some complicated feelings toward him.

facts.fact: Gabriel 来接 Cora 去上课，Rory 躲进浴室不敢见他；他没见到人，语气不快，只让 Anya 带话「晚点见、我想着她」。Anya 随后说她要为女王办事，但会与母亲 Lady Gloria 同在神庙，不让 Rory 独自到场。
facts.anchor: Gabriel arrived to take Cora to her lessons, and I hid, somewhat cowardly, so I wouldn’t have to see him. Through the door, I could hear Anya speak with Gabriel.

facts.fact: Rory 决定白天先应付 Gabriel 的权力排场（包括去神庙），晚上主动去找 Darragh——她不肯让他像惯常那样躲回冷漠的石面具后走掉，要像他当初撬开她的心防那样撬开他的。
facts.anchor: I would endure this display of power and importance to appease Gabriel, and in the evening, I resolved to seek out Darragh. I refused to let him walk away from me.
